description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for processing OpenAI agent messages, including parsing reasoning signatures, handling function call pairings, and downgrading message blocks for compatibility.

methods.name: parseOpenAIReasoningSignature
methods.description: Parses a value to extract an OpenAI reasoning signature if valid.

methods.name: hasFollowingNonThinkingBlock
methods.description: Checks if there is a non-thinking block following a given index in the content array.

methods.name: splitOpenAIFunctionCallPairing
methods.description: Splits a function call ID into callId and itemId parts based on a separator.

methods.name: isOpenAIToolCallType
methods.description: Determines if a given type string corresponds to an OpenAI tool call type.
